_meta.source_request: Founder refinement: anything enforceable or automatable must be enforced/automated; no new oya CLI surface.

description: Seed contract and initial rows for the Phase-0 automation ratchet. This file is not a green claim: it defines the required coverage model and initial founder-decided rows. The Phase-0 gate remains RED until every Phase-0 rule/ADR amendment/operating-contract requirement has a row and every automatable item maps to a Rust gate, cloud-ci controller, generated registry, or fixture-backed bridge with retirement criteria.

reds_when: any Phase-0 acceptance criterion, test, ADR amendment, operating-contract requirement, structural-lock/revert rule, pack-root classifier, generated registry, branch-protection constraint, multispectrum/reviewer requirement, or claim gate lacks a row
an automatable item is classified as not_automatable_human_judgment
a row maps a blocking invariant to an oya CLI invocation
a transitory bridge lacks deletion or cutover criteria

known_gaps_before_green: Local static coverage registry/evaluator and //:phase0-automation-ratchet-check now cover declared AC-0.* and Phase-0 governance subjects, require every seed row to be mapped, and reject oya CLI authority mappings; AC-0.12 remains RED until live cloud-ci/oya-ci evaluates the registry and required context on the candidate SHA.

Checked-in and live GitHub branch-protection contexts now name oya-ci-required, but live required_status_checks.checks binds it to app_id=null, PR #455 has no candidate-SHA checks reported, and live producer evidence is still missing; P0.0 must replace advisory/live-read evidence with trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci required-context production before any green/enforcement claim.
Manual reviewer approval remains operator/procedure evidence until a non-501 reviewer status producer is live and required.

Auto-merge-after-CI is now specified and locally checked for Forgejo plus the GitHub bootstrap mirror, but live Forgejo reachability and GitHub required-context convergence remain RED gap evidence until oya-ci-required is live and required.
non_negotiables: No new oya CLI commands or protected-branch authority are introduced by this matrix.
Operator procedure is a temporary defect unless classified as irreducible human judgment and backed by evidence, owner, and retirement path for automatable subparts.
Mechanically enforced means required cloud-ci context plus RED/GREEN fixtures or an equivalent controller-owned block, not advisory output.

seed_rows.evidence_path: specs/phase0-ci-enforcement-baseline.json + specs/fixtures/phase0-ci-enforcement-baseline/ + specs/fixtures/phase0-required-status-source/ + scripts/tests/phase0_ci_enforcement_baseline_catalog_check.py + scripts/ci/assert-required-status-source.py + infra/branch-protection/dev.json + cloud-ci required-status evidence bundle + specs/phase0-override-packet-schema.json + specs/phase0-trusted-target-inventory-schema.json + scripts/ci/assert-trusted-target-inventory.py + //:phase0-trusted-target-inventory-check + scripts/ci/assert-result-bundle-output.py + //:phase0-result-bundle-output-check
seed_rows.requirement: Protected branch merge/exit authority must be a Prow-shaped cloud-ci/oya-ci required context sourced from trusted trunk/controller state; affected-only/buck2-only/local oya output is not authority.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static and live-read-only RED evidence now detects app_id=null or untrusted required-status source-app binding. This is not P0.0 green or protected-branch authority until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci posts and is source-bound for required oya-ci-required on candidate SHAs.

seed_rows.requirement: Required Buck2 build/test target inventory must be captured from trusted dev/controller state before candidate checkout; candidate PR bytes are data under test and cannot author or weaken the gate catalog.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static fixture gate proves the checked-in trusted target-inventory schema and GOOD/BAD fixtures only. This is not live controller target authority, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci posts the required context on candidate SHAs.

seed_rows.requirement: Structured result bundles must preserve RED/false-green evidence and cannot imply live required-context authority, protected branch authority, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion without trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci status posting on the candidate SHA.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static fixture gate proves the checked-in structured result-bundle schema and RED/false-green fixtures only. This is not live status output, protected-branch authority, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci posts the required context on candidate SHAs.

seed_rows.requirement: Active scripts, CI, CD, and build lanes must use Buck2. Cargo executable lanes are forbidden except production release image/binary optimization evidence and metadata-only Buck2 graph generation.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: //:buck2-authority-policy-check + scripts/ci/enforce-buck2-authority.py + service Jenkins Buck2 bridge lanes + cloud-ci/oya-ci oya-ci-required producer
seed_rows.blocking_fixture: specs/buck2-authority-policy.json forbidden command/context scanner + required_glob_anchors for cloud/*/ci/Jenkinsfile and oya/*/ci/Jenkinsfile + BUCK glob-declared srcs + ADR amendment markers
seed_rows.retirement_phase: P0.0 live cloud-ci/oya-ci required-context cutover; service Jenkins bridge remains non-authority until oya-ci-required is live and required
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static scanner and Buck2 target block checked-in Cargo regressions, including service Jenkinsfiles. This is not P0.0 green or protected-branch authority until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci posts required oya-ci-required on candidate SHA.

seed_rows.requirement: Forgejo and GitHub bootstrap PRs must be armed for automatic merge after CI only when oya-ci-required is the required context, the PR head SHA is pinned, and mergeability/conflict guards pass.
seed_rows.retirement_phase: P0.0 live cloud-ci/oya-ci required-context cutover; GitHub bootstrap mirror path retires after Forgejo-of-record cutover
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/Buck2 checks enforce the checked-in contract. This is not a live auto-merge or P0.0 green claim until oya-ci-required is live, trusted, posted on the candidate SHA, and required by live branch protection.

seed_rows.requirement: Gate-disable or gate-degradation overrides must carry affected required context, degraded gate id, TTL, reviewer acknowledgment, audit-chain event, named owner, blast-radius statement, revert/fix follow-up, and no new oya CLI surface.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static fixture gate proves the checked-in override packet schema and GOOD/BAD override fixtures only. This is not live protected-flow override authority, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci enforces it on candidate SHAs.

seed_rows.evidence_path: docs/AGENTS.md sanctioned primitives + root-hub pointers + CI context inventory
seed_rows.requirement: Retire oya vcs/oya git and prevent oya verify/oya gate from becoming protected-branch CI authority.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: cloud-ci/governance retired-surface scanner + required-context producer check

seed_rows.requirement: Tide/merge queue is owned by cloud-ci/oya-ci now; Phase 0 places admission contract and Phase 1 scales projected-state/batching/auto-rebase.
Pure split removes service-shaped sprawl but preserves ADR-0010/0064 pack roots until explicitly superseded.
Regulated readiness/enforcement/security/completion vocabulary must have live evidence or target/non-claim labeling.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static fixture gate proves seed claim rows and declared BAD/GREEN claim-ceiling fixtures only. This is not live required-context authority, production readiness, hyperscaler-grade readiness, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion.

seed_rows.requirement: Any performance, production-ready, or hyperscaler-grade claim must map to explicit SLI/budget/measurement evidence; advisory benchmarks cannot be authority.
seed_rows.retirement_phase: P0.7/AC-0.17 for claim blocking; Phase 1/2 for measured service budget gates
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: cloud-ci-claim-ceiling + //:phase0-claim-ceiling-check now; cloud-ci-performance-budget release-promotion gate as Phase-1/2 service evidence matures
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static claim-ceiling fixture gate blocks production-ready/hyperscaler-grade performance claims without budget or measured-result evidence. This is not live performance readiness or production readiness.

seed_rows.requirement: Internal and customer tenant pipeline identities, secrets, runners, workspaces, caches, artifacts, logs/evidence, release ledgers, deploy targets, status callbacks, and audit events must be separated before any isolation/tenant-facing claim.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static fixture gate proves the checked-in GOOD/BAD tenant-pipeline isolation contract only. This is not live tenant isolation, security readiness, tenant-facing readiness, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion until trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci runs the gate on candidate SHAs.

seed_rows.requirement: Phase 0 exit is a single aggregate gate over AC-0.0..0.17, fixture coverage, inventory, structural packets, generated registry, automation matrix, claim ceiling, reviewer/multispectrum evidence, and P0.0 required-context/tenant-isolation proof.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: cloud-ci-phase0-aggregate-exit Rust gate packet + //:phase0-aggregate-exit-check local/static fixture target
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static aggregate-exit fixture gate proves required subcondition shape and RED/GREEN fixture non-vacuity only. This is not live required-context authority, P0.0 green, Phase-0 completion, production readiness, or hyperscaler-grade readiness.

seed_rows.requirement: Every enforceable or automatable Phase-0 rule must map to a gate/controller/generated registry/fixture or an explicitly owned human-judgment exception with retirement path.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Local/static fixture gate proves seed-row classification, required-row coverage, coverage-registry row mapping, human-judgment retirement metadata, and no-new-oya-CLI authority constraints only. This is not live required-context authority, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion.

seed_rows.requirement: Generated service/crate inventory must cover every closed-world root and fail on drift or service-like roots outside the allowlist.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: service-inventory generator + cloud-ci inventory drift gate

seed_rows.requirement: Three-axis status enum must be the source of truth for manifest/PRD status fields and status drift must block.
seed_rows.evidence_path: status enum registry + status-drift fixture bundle

seed_rows.requirement: ADR numbering/supersession hygiene must block duplicate or stale canonical decisions, including ADR-0377 and ADR-0511/0513 reconciliation.
Language discipline must block new shell/python test sprawl outside the allowlist and preserve offender inventory.
A2a/A2b D1 contract files must exist, lint valid, and be referenced by the D1 conformance path.
Ontology/effective-dating kernel must expose the bitemporal type and pass unit/property fixtures.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: effective-dating kernel tests + fixture-backed Rust gate

seed_rows.requirement: Post-migration services must live only under canonical oya/ or cloud/ layout while packs/regional-packs remain only authorized shared roots and legacy roots are removed after verified-empty migration.
Every decision must carry the required ADR/spec/masterplan/roadmap agreement set or be blocked.
Structural work must stay serialized with structural-lock/revert fixtures and protected-flow revert evidence; advisory lock output cannot be claimed as mechanical before P0.0 required context.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: structural-lock/revert admission gate + cloud-ci required context

seed_rows.requirement: A2a mutation-result contract must carry the consistency_token field and D1 conformance reference without freezing Phase-2 topology.
The in-memory read-your-writes test must be executable and correctly XFAIL-classified until the real Phase-2 mechanism lands.
Every integrity gate must prove its own known-bad fixture and avoid vacuous pass behavior.
seed_rows.evidence_path: known-bad fixture evidence for gate crates

seed_rows.requirement: Phase-0 Buck2/Cargo reconciliation must prove coverage equality, measure divergence, and start burndown without treating Cargo as CI authority.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: Buck2 target coverage generator + divergence registry gate + //:buck2-cargo-target-coverage-check
seed_rows.blocking_fixture: scripts/tests/buck2_cargo_target_coverage_check.test.sh temp GOOD/BAD repos + checked-in Cargo/Buck2 scan
seed_rows.coverage_note: Local/static AC-0.13 target-coverage measurement only: every Cargo workspace lib/bin target root must have a Buck2 rust crate_root mapping, including parent BUCK files. This is not source-line coverage and not live cloud-ci authority.

seed_rows.requirement: Every enforcement/drift/protocol gate must ship BAD/GOOD fixtures that are deterministic, isolated, self-explaining, fast, and fixture-backed.
Phase 0 must publish conflict taxonomy, generated-artifact registry, merge-tree readiness fixtures, and one-lane-one-path/path-overlap claims without claiming Phase-1 Tide batching.
Decision propagation packets must reconcile ADR/spec/masterplan/register deltas including toolchain authority contradictions.
seed_rows.evidence_path: P0.7 packet manifests + ADR/spec parity evidence

seed_rows.requirement: Generated artifacts must be registered with generator/source/output/commit-policy/regeneration/verification/owner fields; stale or hand-edited generated outputs block.
Every Phase-0 PR must carry multispectrum evidence and reviewer verdict; branch-protection enforcement is claimed only for live non-501 producers.
seed_rows.target_gate_or_controller: required reviewer status target in cloud-ci/oya-ci; manual reviewer verdict is temporary until non-501 producer is live
seed_rows.evidence_path: PR body Code Review section + evidence/multispectrum/*.json + future reviewer-status producer evidence
seed_rows.human_judgment_reason: Final reviewer/architect risk judgment is irreducible human judgment; automatable subparts remain evidence packet completeness, required-status production, and reviewer-status producer cutover.
seed_rows.claim_boundary: Temporary human judgment only for residual design/risk acceptance; not protected-branch authority, P0.0 green, or Phase-0 completion until non-501 reviewer/status producer and cloud-ci evidence packet gates are live.
